en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 186 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Yaqub Kulaini directly that

Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) said when Imam Mahdi (a.s) was born: “The oppressor presumed that they would kill me and cut off this progeny. So how did they witness the might of Allah?” Then he named him Muammal (the one in whom hopes rest).
